INSERT INTO characters
               (first_name, last_name, class, level, reached_60_at, ruleset, battlenet_id)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::smallint,
                   CASE WHEN $4::smallint = 60 THEN COALESCE($5, now()) END,
                   (SELECT ruleset FROM guild_settings), $6)
           RETURNING id
